usage: The word "石" is used as a noun to refer to a stone or rock.
"石" can describe both small stones and large rocks in natural or construction contexts.
It can be used in compound words to specify types of stones, such as gemstones or building stones.
"石" can sometimes appear in expressions relating to weight or measuring units (e.g., "一石" meaning one stone unit).
It is used in everyday conversation when talking about natural materials, landscapes, or objects made of stone.
